scenes.outline: A mistakes damaged folded ticket corners for indexing ritual, copies it, then claims album preservation proves superior care after B explains.
A copies bag-on-head maneuver misunderstood as carrying standard; B was avoiding puddle and offers cart; A competes by choosing more effort and feeding B.
A copies setting menu aside as agreement; B wants clean sticky-menu replacement and no reunion; A reads direct boundaries as surviving intimacy.
A copies question mark in calendar as playful suspense, B means cannot promise; A interprets release of date as caring attention.
A copies cup-upturn as ready-to-pour without understanding drying; B corrects and offers cake; A covers and keeps warm barbs through candle care.
A copies socks on radiator as warming ritual but B is drying them; A covers mistake while offering own warmth and recalling old wait.
A copies tick on invitation as attendance promise, B meant address checked; A converts correction into priced labor after B work conflict.
A copies ribbon on key as gift invitation, B ribbon marks storage cupboard; A confidently prices actual sitting-room access and help in time together.
A copies closed menu as dinner completed before ordering; B reading glasses issue corrects it; A confidently defines short reconnection and another appointment for overflow.
A copies crossed hotel date as optional-night policy, B hotel full; A covers error and offers one pleasant afternoon while relegating difficult talk to email.
